title: Drake and Jennifer Lopez Rekindle Connection After Her Split from Ben Affleck
htmlContent:
There is a rumor that sparks are once again fluttering between two of the most prominent celebrities in entertainment in the world of high-profile celebrity relationships. According to The Jasmine Brand, Canadian rapper Drake and superstar Jennifer Lopez have been getting closer since Lopez's recent split from husband Ben Affleck. Almost immediately after the news broke, Drake was astonished by Lopez, 55, who filed for divorce from Affleck, 52, in August. An insider told In Touch that the 37-year-old singer from 'Hotline Bling' wasted no time contacting Lopez with supportive words and a clear romantic interest.
“As soon as she filed the papers, Drake reached out. He was very sweet and told her what a fool Ben is for letting her get away, and then he quickly let her know he’s ready and willing to step in and satisfy her,” the source revealed.
Despite Lopez not seeking a serious relationship, Drake appears to be fulfilling a specific role in her life. The source added additional information.
“He definitely meets her needs for a hook-up. He’s very intelligent and romantic, and she can count on him being discreet because he’s always kept her secrets in the past.”
After sharing cozy photos on Instagram, the couple, who were first romantically linked in 2016, have a past that includes attending a prom-themed party where they were reportedly seen kissing. Lopez confirmed in 2017 that they had been hanging out, but she never elaborated on the true nature of their relationship. According to the source, the connection between them seems to have been rekindled.
“They have their own history and a lot of chemistry, so it really did a lot to make her smile. Getting that kind of attention when she was feeling so low was exactly what she needed. Now they’re texting every day, and things are getting hot.”
Reports suggest that the couple is currently sexting and sharing flirty selfies, even though the relationship is still in its early stages. Drake's attention has been a welcome distraction for Lopez during this challenging time. The source states, "He lays it on thick with compliments, and she loves hearing from him." As fans and media outlets continue to speculate about whether this will turn out to be a more severe affair or remain a casual fling, Drake and Jennifer Lopez have a strong connection that has come to light at a time when she needs it most. Time will dictate whether this renewed closeness will become more substantial or a temporary spark in their busy lives. The entertainment world is currently filled with curiosity about the potential rekindling of romance.
